description:
## What to build

Now that classification lives in one pure place (classify_entry), make it stop drifting from Nix. Two known discrepancies:

1. Skill bundles (e.g. mattpocock-skills, _meta.fromClaudePlugin: true) currently fall through and are mislabeled as plain packages in the docs. They should be recognized as their own category (or explicitly folded, by decision).
2. Python decides 'toolchain' by name.endswith('-toolchain'); Nix decides by which builder (buildToolchain) is used. Reconcile the rule so the two sides agree.

## Decision needed (human)

How should a skill bundle render in the generated docs? Its own section, folded into packages, or omitted? This gates the implementation and is why the ticket is ready-for-human, not agent-grabbable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Decision recorded (likely an ADR under docs/adr/) on how skill bundles and the toolchain rule are classified for docs
- [ ] classify_entry recognizes skill bundles per the decision, no longer silently treating them as plain packages
- [ ] Toolchain classification rule reconciled with Nix's builder-based notion (or the divergence documented as intentional)
- [ ] Tests cover the new classification branches with dict fixtures
- [ ] Generated docs reflect the decided treatment

## Blocked by

- Extract pure classify_entry; make scan_packages a thin walk (tb-dkx.1)
title: Reconcile Nix/skill-bundle classification drift in classify_entry
